# 3BrainAI

> 3BrainAI Nexus is developing CRI – Construction Risk Intelligence, a review-support product combining dated satellite observations and authorised project records in versioned Evidence Packs for bank review.

## Primary audience

- Banks and institutional lenders.
- Credit risk and portfolio monitoring teams.
- Commercial real-estate and project-finance teams.
- Collateral and progress-review roles.

## Core product

- [3BrainAI CRI](https://www.3brain.ai/cri/): Construction Risk Intelligence for governed institutional review.
- [Evidence Pack portfolio](https://www.3brain.ai/#portfolio): Fischamend is the primary Austrian public-safe case; earlier German prototypes remain accessible as historical concept evidence.
- [Fischamend Evidence Pack](https://www.3brain.ai/evidence-packs/fischamend/): Illustrative public-safe release for a hypothetical construction review question; not a live customer assessment.
- [Validation](https://www.3brain.ai/validation/): Complete product history and a separate institution-specific engagement path beginning with an Evidence Readiness Check.

Current stage: controlled-case Proof of Concept validation of the governed Evidence Pack workflow is in progress. The next product gate is a contracted paid pilot. Product history remains visible from completed idea definition and illustrative prototype work through current PoC, next Paid Pilot and target Commercial Deployment. Institution-specific engagement is a separate axis beginning with an Evidence Readiness Check; institution-specific validation is normally run in shadow mode alongside existing controls.

## Bank review questions

- [Bank review use cases](https://www.3brain.ai/use-cases/): intended workflows and evidence boundaries for construction finance and collateral.
- [Construction loan drawdown review](https://www.3brain.ai/use-cases/construction-loan-drawdown-review/): Compare a declared milestone with dated observations and the records needed for a scoped technical review.
- [Real-estate collateral review](https://www.3brain.ai/use-cases/real-estate-collateral-review/): Separate a visible change near a property from a conclusion about its value, condition or credit risk.
- [Satellite evidence: uses and limits](https://www.3brain.ai/use-cases/satellite-evidence-limits/): Understand acquisition dates, optical and radar observations, aerial context and the point at which interpretation must stop.

## Company and verification

- 3BrainAI is the public brand. 3BrainAI Nexus s.r.o. is developing 3BrainAI CRI.
- 3BrainAI is a European startup for institutional markets, with an initial focus on DACH, Benelux and Central Europe and a head office in Prague.
- 3BrainAI Nexus s.r.o. is participating in the ESA Business Incubation Centre Czech Republic. Participation does not imply endorsement, product validation or customer status.
- [About](https://www.3brain.ai/about/): Founder, entity boundaries and institutional milestones.
- [Investors](https://www.3brain.ai/investors/): Public-safe bank-first investor overview; detailed materials remain private.
- [Contact](https://www.3brain.ai/contact/): Separate bank-validation and investor routes.
- [Imprint](https://www.3brain.ai/imprint/): Legal entities and website operator.
- [Security, Governance & Assurance](https://www.3brain.ai/assurance/): Product boundaries, accountable roles and contact routes for scoped due diligence and security enquiries.

## Boundaries

- CRI supports accountable human review. It does not make autonomous credit decisions, replace bank policy or replace professional assessment.
- In shadow mode, CRI outputs are reviewed alongside existing processes and do not affect live financial, operational or risk decisions; existing controls remain in place.
- Public Evidence Pack examples distinguish real dated observations from hypothetical review scenarios; they do not represent client engagements.
- Earth Observation is an input medium. CRI is the review-support product being developed; the Evidence Pack is its versioned review record.
- Source, observation date, version, uncertainty and review state are designed to remain attached to each Evidence Pack record.

## Professional evaluation

- [Evidence Pack overview](https://www.3brain.ai/evidence-packs/): public output format and links to the published record.
- [The Brief](https://www.3brain.ai/cri/#the-brief): nine prepared model situations across Austria, Czechia and the Netherlands. Editorial evaluation access is free and individually reviewed; other professional access is agreed separately. A request does not grant access or buy a bank pilot.
